claims: The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
There will be no trading sessions on Good Friday, April 3, 2026 for the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq).
The U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) will reopen for regular trading on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Bond markets close early at noon on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
The bond market closes early at 12 p.m. ET on Good Friday, 2026.
No regular, pre-market, or after-hours trading takes place on Good Friday, April 3, 2026 for NYSE and Nasdaq.
Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
Good Friday is a traditional stock market holiday.
The practice of observing Good Friday as a stock market holiday has been in place since the late 19th century.
